subject: Reserved GPU pools architecture sync — planning session

Subject: Request: architecture deep-dive for reserved GPU pools

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team at Acme Health is excited about Redwood's approach to reserved GPU pools. We have a few follow-up technical items the infra and procurement teams want to walk through before we commit to Dedicated: specifically pool sizing guidance for our peak inference windows, autoscaling behavior for mixed workloads, and isolation options for PHI workloads.

Would your engineering team be available for a 60–75 minute architecture session the week of Oct 26? We can share workload traces and a short doc with current token/sec profiles ahead of time.

A couple of suggested slots (PST):
- Tue Oct 27, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Oct 28, 13:00–14:15
- Thu Oct 29, 09:00–10:15

Please let me know which works or propose alternatives. Priya from our infra team (cc'd) will join.

Cheers,
Jason
Principal SRE, Acme Health Systems

Hi Jason — thanks for the clear agenda. We can do a focused architecture session and would appreciate the traces in advance.

Quick notes on availability: 60–75 minutes is perfect. Tue Oct 27 at 10:00 PST is OK for Marissa and Karthik, but our Solutions Lead (Marissa) asked if we can push an hour later to give her time to finish another customer call. Could you do Tue Oct 27 at 11:00–12:15 PST instead? If not, Thu Oct 29 09:00 PST is still open.

Proposed agenda (we'll expand if you want):
1) 10–15 min: Goal alignment + current Acme workload profile (you)
2) 25–30 min: Redwood reserved pools model (sizing heuristics, isolation tiers, pricing tradeoffs)
3) 15–20 min: Autoscaling strategies + fallback policies for noisy neighbors
4) 10–15 min: Q&A and next steps (pilot scope, artifact requests)

I'll upload a short slide pack and a pool-sizing worksheet. Sending a placeholder calendar invite once you confirm the time.

Best,
Grace O'Connor

Hi Grace — 11:00–12:15 PST on Tue Oct 27 will be tight for Priya (overnight pager rotation) — she asked if we could move to Thu Oct 29 09:00–10:15 PST instead. That slot will work well for the infra team and gives us time to circulate traces.

Jason
